blends.name: 450 Twitch Stream Bananas (12 green tickets)
blends.desc: Blend 12 green tickets tickets and you will receive a redeemable NFT worth 450 Twitch Stream Bananas. Once you receive the reedemable in your wallet you will then transfer the redeemable NFT to the lasvegaskind wallet with a memo that says redeem. You will get your prize within 24 hours, usually much shorter.
